title: New rooms in your design
intro: A few things have been added since you were last here. Each one feeds your coach, so your conversations can go further.

items.title: Goals at four horizons
items.body: A SMART goal for the next few months, an objective with key results for the year, a vivid picture of life a few years out, and a life-long reflection on who you hope to become. Each asks what's in the way, and what you'll do.

items.title: Life experiences
items.body: A ledger for the experiences you want to live, from "still ahead" to "lived", with what each one taught you.

items.title: Open at every level
items.body: Work on any part of your pyramid whenever you feel ready. Tap any step on your path, and your coach will help it trace back to the foundation.
